cases.reviewerAnswer: Me gusta el café expresses liking; necesito un café expresses need; quiero un café expresses desire.

cases.defect: Descanso is also a noun meaning rest. The reviewed sentence can therefore express wanting rest at the weekend, rather than an erroneous second conjugated verb. cases.reviewerAnswer: a and b: Esta noche is explicit; Por la noche also fits when today's evening is established by the prompt.
cases.element: task.options[id=b]: "Por la noche" is marked incorrect; feedbackUk: "Por la noche — «увечері» загалом (часто про звичку). «Сьогодні ввечері» — esta noche."
cases.defect: Por la noche can refer to a particular evening supplied by context. The prompt explicitly establishes today, so Por la noche voy al cine can express the stated plan. The task does not ask which expression explicitly encodes today.
cases.correction: Accept both a and b, or ask which expression explicitly means "сьогодні ввечері". Explain that por la noche can accompany either a habit or a specific occasion.
